answer: A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The tundra counter is kept in spiral and grove exposes each reset. An adversary as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 9 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
